convergent_window_hypotheses.description: CW-001: UZ AI-in-Courts platform (УП-140, RFP expected Q3-Q4 2026). Lenses: karimov_inversion + decree_half_life_active + donor_co_financed + russian_cis_substitution.
CW-002: UZ AI Cluster New Uzbekistan University (УП-189, deadline 1.03.2026). Compute infrastructure + curriculum + Nvidia partnership integration.
CW-003: UZ Координационная комиссия $100M distribution criteria-shaping window (ПП-320, criteria not yet finalized; window May-Sept 2026 for vendor influence; Q4 2026 grant applications).
CW-004: KG UDP Digital Department foundational TORs (post-April 2026 reorg). New decision-makers will draft new project TORs for every legacy Минцифры program.
CW-005: KG digital som CBDC infrastructure procurement (in force January 2027). Wallet, AML, KYC; Q2-Q4 2026 procurement window.
CW-006: UZ E-Health platform expansion, e-prescription anti-fraud and clinical decision support AI.
CW-007: UZ EPIGU 1000+ services chatbot / agentic citizen workflows.
CW-008: KG Tunduk-within-UDP modernization (Estonian EGA-led, EU-funded).
CW-009: UZ Geospatial NSDI imagery-analysis tenders ($35M WB Cadastre 2025-2030).
CW-010: KG Цифровой Кодекс secondary regulations drafting (May-Q4 2026). Standards-shaping for AI auditability, model registries, testing.
